db.sql: select `l`.`tenantId` AS `tenantId`,`l`.`id` AS `locationId`,`l`.`locationName` AS `locationName`,`l`.`locationType` AS `locationType`,`l`.`isActive` AS `locationIsActive`,`s`.`id` AS `spaceId`,`s`.`spaceName` AS `spaceName`,`s`.`spaceType` AS `spaceType`,`s`.`defaultCapacity` AS `defaultCapacity`,`s`.`isActive` AS `spaceIsActive`,`c`.`id` AS `configurationId`,`c`.`configurationName` AS `configurationName`,`c`.`seatedCapacity` AS `seatedCapacity`,`c`.`standingCapacity` AS `standingCapacity`,`c`.`maximumTotalCapacity` AS `maximumTotalCapacity`,`c`.`staffCrewAllowance` AS `staffCrewAllowance`,`c`.`setupMinutes` AS `setupMinutes`,`c`.`resetMinutes` AS `resetMinutes`,`c`.`minimumStaff` AS `minimumStaff`,`c`.`minimumSecurityStaff` AS `minimumSecurityStaff`,`c`.`isDefault` AS `isDefault`,`c`.`isActive` AS `configurationIsActive` from ((`task_tracker`.`tbl_locations` `l` left join `task_tracker`.`tbl_spaces` `s` on(`s`.`tenantId` = `l`.`tenantId` and `s`.`locationId` = `l`.`id`)) left join `task_tracker`.`tbl_space_configurations` `c` on(`c`.`tenantId` = `s`.`tenantId` and `c`.`spaceId` = `s`.`id`))
